unique_value: each mission thread owns isolated mutable state under its own authority token; direct cross-thread reads do not share state
cross-thread transfer requires an explicit export grant with bounded lifetime rather than ambient shared authority
exports can be single-use, explicitly revoked, and are automatically invalidated when their source thread closes
export ownership and import rules fail closed on bad authority, expiry, reuse, unknown exports, self-import, closed sources, and non-owner revocation
